metadata.description: 논문·강의자료를 TTS 내레이션 설명 영상으로 만드는 스킬

plugins.name: paper2video
plugins.description: Turn an academic paper into a narrated explainer video (MP4 + subtitles) with a real 3D world, chart templates and every number fact-checked against the paper. Offline voices. Korean by default.

plugins.name: lecture2video
plugins.description: Turn lecture slides (PDF) into narrated review episodes on the real slides, with quizzes, soft subtitles and chapters (MP4), every fact checked against the slides. Offline voices. Korean by default.
